subject: Re: Context length & token profile — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Bob Li <bob.li@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Context length & token profile — pricing follow-up

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for the call today — good conversation and clear use cases. Quick recap + asks so we can put together an indicative pricing pack and a recommended serving config: 

Recap from our call:
- Workload: multi-turn customer support + summarization pipeline with occasional long-document retrieval for enterprise customers.
- Expected steady-state usage: roughly 6.5B tokens/month across prod requests (see detail request below).
- Latency SLOs: 1.5s p95 for short prompts; willing to tune for longer-context fast-paths.

Information we need to finalize an indicative price: 
1) Token profile (avg per request): avg prompt tokens, avg completion tokens (please provide mean +/- 90th).
2) Distribution tail: percent of requests requiring >8k, >32k, and >128k context.
3) Peak qps and acceptable batching windows (helps with unit economics).
4) Target budgeting: target $/1M tokens you want to land (ballpark fine).

Would you be able to send a small sample (anonymized) CSV or logs with per-request prompt/completion token counts? A short sample (1-3k rows) is perfect for us to profile and estimate 8k/32k/128k needs.

Next steps I propose:
- Acme to share sample token-profile CSV + monthly token estimate (you mentioned 6-8B range).
- We'll run a context-length profile and produce three indicative pricing points (hosted 8k, hosted 32k, and hosted 128k) with unit $/1M tokens and a recommended rollout plan.
- If you want, we can schedule an SE deep-dive this week to go through performance/latency trade-offs.

I’ve attached a one-pager on our pricing bands and an empty CSV template (context-profiling.csv). Looking forward to the sample — happy to work within a target $/1M if you have a range in mind.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: context-profiling.csv (csv, 28KB)

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context length & token profile — pricing follow-up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the template. Per our internal profiling and a quick export from our staging logs (high-level numbers below). I attached a small CSV extract (context-profiling.csv) with 2,500 anonymized rows.

Summary numbers (last 30 days, staging):
- Monthly tokens (prod projected): 6,500,000,000 tokens/month (we expect growth into ~8B over next 6 months).
- Avg prompt tokens: 120 (median 74; 90th percentile 420).
- Avg completion tokens: 380 (median 200; 90th percentile 1,400).
- Percent of requests by context requirement: ~5% >8k, ~0.8% >32k, ~0.02% >128k.
- Peak qps (30s window): ~210 rps; peak batching tolerance: ~50-100ms (customer-facing).

On budget: our procurement team is targeting roughly $100-150 per 1M tokens for hosted inference. Our preference is an all-in unit price that scales down with volume/commit.

Let us know if any of the numbers need clarification. We can also run a longer export if you need >10k rows.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director, Product — AI Platform
Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme.com

Attachment: context-profiling.csv (csv, 82KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 15:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context length & token profile — pricing follow-up

Thanks Alice — this is exactly what we needed. Quick notes on what we'll run and the initial implications: 

1) Profiling plan
- We'll ingest the 2.5k-row CSV and compute: avg/median/90/99 token counts, tail percentiles for >8k/32k/128k, and a per-request cost estimate using three config profiles (8k, 32k, 128k).

2) Unit economics implications (high-level)
- With avg total tokens/request ~= 500 tokens (prompt+completion), 6.5B tokens/mo translates to ~13M requests/mo.
- If Acme targets $120 / 1M tokens, monthly cost (hosted) would be ~$780,000/mo (6.5 * $120k).
- Tail traffic (>8k and >32k) drives incremental cost because of larger context memory + slower throughput; those will be reflected in the per-M token pricing for 32k/128k tiers.

3) Questions for SE quote
- Do you expect the >128k requests to be bursty (short-lived) or steady? If bursty, we may recommend on-demand fallback to a larger context model vs. always provisioning 128k capacity.
- Any regulatory constraints requiring private deployment? That will change contractual terms.

Next steps
- Michael (cc'd) will run the profiling and put together three indicative pricing points and a short notes doc explaining assumptions (tokenization, typical response length assumptions, batching window).
- I’ll send an initial pricing estimate PDF and a HubSpot quote link once we have the profiling run.
- Proposed SE deep-dive: Wed 24 Mar, 10:00-10:30 PT — does that work for your team?

Quoted from your note: 
> Avg prompt tokens: 120 (median 74; 90th 420)
> Avg completion tokens: 380 (median 200; 90th 1,400)
> Percent >8k: ~5%; >32k: ~0.8%; >128k: ~0.02%

I’ve attached a quick pricing one-pager (redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf) with our current public-ish bands so you have a baseline while we run the numbers.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Context length & token profile — pricing follow-up

Michael / Jordan — looping you both in to action the profiling and quote. Key asks from Acme:
- Confirm unit-costs for hosted 8k / 32k / 128k options that land near their target ~$120 / 1M tokens (we may need to propose a committed tier to get there).
- Produce a short note on recommended serving config: batching, KV cache settings, quantization/precision trade-offs.
- Estimate committed capacity required to hit $120 / 1M (e.g., 12-18 month commit and minimum tokens/mo).

I’ve attached the CSV sample (from Acme) and their numbers. Please prioritize — they’re aiming to finalize budgeting next week.

Thanks —
Marissa
